F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to soft, fine-grained, shaggy fibrous texture, typically in warm tan, brown or cream tones and often where that fuzzy texture meets a smoother region. It also responds more weakly to related soft, plush-looking surfaces and to the surroundings next to such textured masses.

It also responds more weakly to related soft, plush-looking surfaces and to the surroundings next to such textured masses.
parsed.evidence: All 20 top images contain prominent regions of dense, tufted, hair-like texture, and most red boxes sit on or at the edge of those regions.
